run_detect_layout_cli: run detect_layout_cli to detect layout of PDFs or images from an input file or folder
run_layout_predictor: run LayoutPredictor on a list of images to produce layout bounding box predictions
run_foundation_predictor: run FoundationPredictor with a layout model checkpoint to build the inference backbone
draw_polys_on_image: draw polys on image with layout bounding box polygons and labels for visualization
save_layout_predictions_json: save layout predictions grouped by page into a results.json file
